claims_coverage.note: All 240 claims in claims.yaml (213 computation, 16 source, 5 interpretation, 4 assumption, 2 definition) match verbatim passages in paper/PAPER.md, and all 213 computation pointers and formatted values match simulation/output/results.json within their declared decimal tolerances. Line-by-line inspection of PAPER.md lines 6–236 found no unbound quantitative values; the only unbound tokens are identifiers (Kir2.1, TRPV4, PIP2), mathematical expression constants (e.g., 1 in 1 + exp, 0 in F(0) and G_V(t) = 0), unit exponents (mol^-1, K^-1, mM^1/2), Markdown image widths (100%, 88%), and the pinned Moshkforoush commit SHA.

contribution_after.assessment: Following revision, the paper remains a useful synthesis rather than an independently validated new biological result. While it provides an invariant pooled-controller null theorem (G_V = 0), exact output-saturation residual algebra, and calibrated concentration-reversal and sample-size bounds attached to Longden (2026) and Moshkforoush et al. (2020), it relies entirely on those published model equations, includes no new experimental measurements, and confirms that the reversible active regime sits completely outside measured capillary Kir conductances (0/29 overlap; 0/125 measured-band passes even with slow Kir/TRPV4 modulation).

source_claims.note: Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/longden2017.txt (Results and Fig. 2 text): documents capillary K+-sensing retrograde hyperpolarization (-23.2 ± 1.8 mV to 10 mM K+, 240 ± 30 ms onset latency), <100 uM Ba2+ block, and ablation of KIR currents in EC KIR2.1-/- mice.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/moshkforoush2020.txt (Results, Fig. 5 caption, and main-text discussion of saddle-node bifurcations and SI Fig. S7): explicitly shows threshold excitation and states that graded responses can be achieved by summation of binary inputs from multiple activated capillary network regions (note: SI Appendix Fig. S7 file failed to fetch, as recorded in sources.md).

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/postnov2015.txt: hypothesizes and analyzes bistability powered by negative differential resistance/conductance from an N-shaped whole-cell I-V curve to support regenerative conducted pulse transmission along vascular endothelium.

Inspected Crossref-registered abstract in simulation/data/source_evidence/rivers1997.crossref.json: methacholine applied simultaneously at 1 to 4 sites along a single hamster cheek-pouch arteriole reached a limited ~5 um maximum even at 10-fold higher concentration or longer duration, whereas dilations became cumulative when initiated on adjacent arterioles. Full text was not inspected.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/longden2026.txt (Abstract, signal-combining sections, and experimental outlook): explicitly frames capillary arithmetic, temporal/spatial combination of hyperpolarizing signals, current shunts via Cl- clamping, and impaling a bifurcating capillary with two current-injection electrodes plus an upstream voltage-recording electrode.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/isaacs2024.txt (Significance, Results): shows optogenetic hyperpolarization of individual thin-strand pericytes dilates upstream penetrating arterioles and implicates pericyte KATP channels via pinacidil, genetic disruption, laser ablation, and glibenclamide inhibition.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/hariharan2022.txt (Abstract and Results text): demonstrates that lowering extracellular glucose (<1 mM) or blocking GLUT1 flips an energy switch activating pericyte KATP-mediated hyperpolarization and Kir2.1-dependent retrograde upstream blood-flow increases.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/moshkforoush2020.txt (Methods, Multicellular Models): states verbatim that Rgj has not been measured in capillaries and therefore explores 10 MOhm to 1 GOhm based on arterial endothelial estimates and cytoplasmic calculations.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/behringer2012.fulltext.txt (Methods and Results): shows SKCa/IKCa activation (NS309, SKA-31, ACh) in skeletal-muscle endothelial tubes shortens the electrical length constant lambda from 1380 to 850 um and reduces conducted hyperpolarization by >=50% via signal dissipation through lowered membrane resistance while propidium iodide dye coupling remains intact.

Inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/kapela2018.fulltext.txt (Results, Table 1, Conclusions): estimates endothelial Rm = 12 GOhm and Rgj = 4.5 MOhm and models how the interplay between gap-junction resistance and membrane resistance (KCa channel opening) jointly governs signal initiation and electrical conduction.

Verified DOI 10.1523/jneurosci.19-14-05875.1999 via Crossref API and inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/wessel1999.fulltext.txt (Abstract, Modeling Equations 3–4, Fig. 7): demonstrates Kir-dependent supralinear summation of paired excitatory synaptic inputs in leech anterior pagoda cells and reproduces it with Kir (GKir2(V)) as the sole voltage-dependent conductance alongside passive leak and axial coupling.

Verified DOI 10.1080/10739680490457836 via Crossref API and inspected Crossref-registered abstract in simulation/data/source_evidence/crane2004.crossref.json: reports transient ACh-induced conducted hyperpolarization areas exceeding passive predictions in 11/15 smooth muscle and 5/7 endothelial intracellular recordings in hamster cheek-pouch arterioles. Full text was not inspected.

Verified DOI 10.1113/jphysiol.2005.090233 via Crossref API and inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/diep2005.fulltext.txt (Abstract, Results/Discussion): demonstrates in skeletal-muscle resistance-artery models that cellular orientation and gap-junctional coupling resistance control differential spread along ECs vs SMCs and filter transient events into sustained voltage responses.

Verified DOI 10.1016/j.bpj.2012.01.055 via Crossref API and inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/hald2012.fulltext.txt (Discussion, Reaching steady state): shows membrane resistance rm depends nonlinearly on Vm along arterioles, yet an exponential decay function still fits almost all simulated conduction profiles well away from the stimulus site.

Verified DOI 10.1159/000439112 via Crossref API and inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/segal2015.fulltext.txt (endothelial-tube discussion): explains that opening plasma-membrane K+ channels inhibits intercellular conducted electrical signaling along the endothelium while gap junctions remain fully patent as confirmed by robust dye transfer.

Verified DOI 10.7554/elife.38689 via Crossref API and inspected simulation/data/source_evidence/harraz2018.fulltext.txt (Results on reciprocal channel regulation, Fig. 6C): reports PGE2-induced PIP2 depletion reciprocally activates TRPV4 and suppresses Kir2.1 currents in brain cECs at room temperature with fitted exponential time constants tau = 4.9 min (294 s) and 6.4 min (384 s).

summary: All 10 prior findings (harness:H1 and hydrogen:F1–F9) are resolved and verified against REVIEW/diff.patch, paper/PAPER.md, simulation code, live Crossref lookups, and direct recomputations: verification/paired-study.json now uses portable relative paths with matching SHA256 hashes for all 17 inputs and 10 artifacts; all 25 unit tests pass in-memory; design selection targets the invariant pooled-input null under simultaneous 10 mM stimulation (G_V = 0.8333 mV, 46 observations/condition; 129 and 96 from ensembles); the pooled controller enforces tau >= 10 ms on a calibrated tanh architecture driven by the fitted passive cable with its bound-pinning and poorer singleton fit (0.575 mV) explicitly disclosed; the 11.80–11.85 mM and 12.05–12.10 mM sign-inversion brackets and local diagnostics are quantified and step-refined; local vulnerability (503/513 singleton matches, 241 persistent failures, 0/29 overlap with [0.139, 0.485] nS) and the negative slow-reset test (0/125 measured-band grid passes; 7/7 nominal Kir-only relief) are transparently reported; protocol timing switches to simultaneous stimulation and preparation-specific response-aligned windows; the T3 sensor_only NaN bug is fixed (R_V = 2.4669 mV at d=0); all 7 Crossref-verified references are engaged without overclaiming inspection depth (rall1967 identity-only and omitted from claims.yaml); habitual ', not' and 'rather than' framing and trailing disclaimers are removed with a 183-word abstract; and all 240 claim bindings check out. One minor new visual defect remains on page 14 (Figure 3 / concentration_boundary.png), where the 'Delay 0 ms' curve overlaps the '11.80–11.85 mM' label and crosses behind the legend box. After revision, the paper stands as a useful synthesis.
